headline: Central Bank of Nigeria and NNPC Sign MoU to Unlock Oil Revenue and Boost Forex Inflows
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria and the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited signed a Memorandum of Understanding to improve foreign exchange inflows and enhance petroleum revenue management for macroeconomic stability.
why: Nigeria is Africa's largest oil exporter, and coordination between its central bank and state oil company is vital for stabilizing foreign exchange reserves and currency liquidity.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: An agreement to manage petroleum proceeds aims to enhance foreign exchange inflows and macroeconomic stability.
